王野抱着王笑笑出了门就去了平三卓家，兄妹两个一人背着一个包，尤其是小丫头后面的小青蛙，那真是相当的吸引目光的。王笑笑也知道大家都在看她，还很神气的在王野怀里挺了挺身子。

王野在快到平三卓家时，从空间里拿出了两斤羊肉放在包里。一进门就看见平三卓正在院子里休息。有一个老妇人在屋里收拾桌子。王野见平三卓躺在躺椅上假寐，就叫了一声“师父”。

平三卓睁开眼：“小野来啦！哟，笑笑丫头也来啦！”

王野对着王笑笑说道：“笑笑，叫师父。”

王笑笑对于王野的话那是相当听的，立刻奶声奶气的叫了一声：“师父”。

这时屋里的老妇人也出来了，平三卓介绍说：“小野，这是你师娘。”

王野满脸笑容的叫了一声：“师娘”。

王笑笑这次也没有等王野教她，也跟着叫了一声：“师娘”。

这可把老太太高兴坏了。赶紧接过王野怀里的小丫头。

王野从包里拿出事先准备好的羊肉，递给师娘：“师娘，这是我昨天从朋友那里换的，给你和师父尝尝鲜。”

老太太看向平三卓，见平三卓微微点头后，老太太才接过王野递的羊肉，然后笑呵呵抱着王笑笑就进屋了。

平三卓起身：“以后不许了，你师父还是有点关系的，也不缺吃喝，用不着你孝敬，你还在长身体，这时候要多吃肉食。我在拳脚上虽然不如赵老头，但是也算是半个江湖人。”

“师父，你放心吧，我在老家认识很多猎人，从来没有缺过肉食。昨天我还从老家拉回来一头野猪呢！我是怕您吃不惯野猪肉，才给您带了点儿羊肉。”

平三卓也没有继续在这个问题上多说：“小野，走，跟我去书房。”

在平三卓的引领下，两人进了书房。这间书房很大，除了中间一张书桌，周围全是到顶的书柜。每个书柜上都摆满了书籍。平三卓坐在书桌前，指了指对面的椅子让王野坐下。

平三卓轻咳一声：“小野，我先跟你说说咱这一脉。在中医界也是有门派的，咱们这一脉属于华阳派，中医中的派别不像江湖中那样，是按中医的侧重划分的。”

“除了咱们华阳派还有很多派别，像什么伤寒派，滋阴派，温补派，火神派等等，大部分都是按学术划分的。咱们华阳派注重的是针灸，咱也有压箱底儿的绝学，就是阴阳九针。”

“咳，可是这么多年下来，咱们的针法也有一部分失传。现在的阴阳九针只剩下阴三针，阳三针了。剩下的夺命三针，我研究了一辈子都没有搞懂。”

说着从书桌的暗格里拿出一个木盒子，打开木盒，从里面拿出一本古朴的线装书。王野一看就知道这本书有年头了。

平三卓把书递给王野：“这本书现在不能出这间书房。以你的记忆力想要背过应该不难。现在你先不用理解其中的内容，先死记硬背下来。接下来我再给你讲解。”

说完就自己也拿出了一本医书开始看了起来。

背书对于王野来说真的没什么难度。王野从翻开第一页开始，到王野把书合上，一共也没有一个小时。就算平三卓知道王野很妖孽，可还是觉得不可思议，他惊讶地看着王野：“这就背完了？”

王野“嘿嘿”一笑：“背是背过了，可是一句话也不懂。这里面的字我都认识，可是连起来就不知道什么意思了。”

Wang Ye hugged Wang Xiaoxiao and went out to Ping Sanzhuo's house. The brother and sister each carried a bag, especially the little frog behind the little girl, which was really eye-catching.Wang Xiaoxiao also knew that everyone was looking at her, and she stood up proudly in Wang Ye's arms.

When Wang Ye was approaching Ping Sanzhuo's house, he took out two kilograms of mutton from the space and put it in his bag.As soon as he entered the door, he saw Ping Sanzhuo resting in the yard.There was an old woman clearing the table in the room.When Wang Ye saw Ping Sanzhuo lying on the recliner and dozing off, he called out "Master".

Ping Sanzhuo opened his eyes: "Xiaoye is here! Oh, Xiaoxiao girl is here too!"

Wang Ye said to Wang Xiaoxiao: "Xiaoxiao, call me Master."

Wang Xiaoxiao listened very well to Wang Ye's words, and immediately called out in a sweet voice: "Master".

At this time, the old woman in the room also came out. Ping Sanzhuo introduced: "Xiaoye, this is your master's wife."

Wang Ye called out: "Master's Wife" with a smile on his face.

Wang Xiaoxiao did not wait for Wang Ye to teach her this time, and also called out: "Master's wife".

This made the old lady very happy.He quickly took the little girl from Wang Ye's arms.

Wang Ye took out the prepared mutton from his bag and handed it to his wife: "Master's wife, I bought this from my friend yesterday. I'll give it to you and Master to try."

The old lady looked at Ping Sanzhuo, and after seeing Ping Sanzhuo nodded slightly, the old lady took the mutton from Wang Ye, then hugged Wang Xiaoxiao with a smile and entered the house.

Ping Sanzhuo stood up and said, "I won't do it anymore. Your master still has some connections, and there is no shortage of food and drink. You don't need to be filial. You are still growing, so you need to eat more meat at this time. Although I am not as good as Old Zhao in boxing and kicking, I can still be regarded as half a Jianghu person."

"Master, don't worry. I know many hunters in my hometown, and I never lack meat. Yesterday, I brought back a wild boar from my hometown! I was afraid that you wouldn't be used to wild boar, so I brought you some mutton."

Ping Sanzhuo did not continue to say more on this issue: "Xiaoye, let's go to the study with me."

Under the guidance of Ping Sanzhuo, the two entered the study.This study room is very large. Except for a desk in the middle, it is surrounded by bookcases that reach to the top.Every bookcase is filled with books.Ping Sanzhuo sat at the desk and pointed to the chair opposite for Wang Ye to sit down.

Ping Sanzhuo coughed lightly: "Xiaoye, let me tell you about our lineage first. There are also sects in the world of Chinese medicine. Our lineage belongs to the Huayang sect. The sects in Chinese medicine are not divided according to the emphasis of Chinese medicine like in Jianghu."

"In addition to our Huayang sect, there are many sects, such as the typhoid sect, the nourishing yin sect, the warming sect, the Vulcan sect, etc. Most of them are divided according to academics. Our Huayang sect focuses on acupuncture, and we also have the most unique secret, which is the Yin and Yang Nine Needles."

"Ahem, but after so many years, part of our acupuncture techniques have been lost. Now of the nine Yin and Yang needles, only three Yin needles and three Yang needles are left. I have been studying the remaining three life-threatening needles for a lifetime but I still can't understand them."

As he spoke, he took out a wooden box from the secret compartment of the desk, opened the wooden box, and took out a simple thread-bound book from inside.Wang Ye could tell at a glance that the book was old.

Ping Sanzhuo handed the book to Wang Ye: "This book cannot leave this study now. It shouldn't be difficult to memorize it with your memory. You don't need to understand the content now, just memorize it by rote. I will explain it to you later."

After saying that, he took out a medical book and started reading.

Endorsement is really not difficult for Wang Ye.From the time Wang Ye opened the first page to the time Wang Ye closed the book, it didn't take an hour in total.Even though Ping Sanzhuo knew that Wang Ye was a monster, he still found it unbelievable. He looked at Wang Ye in surprise: "Is this the end of memorizing?"

Wang Ye smiled "hehe": "I have memorized it, but I don't understand a word. I know all the words in it, but I don't know what it means when they are put together."
